searchText: I've made a PR to add support for 'Sepolia' - the new PoW testnet which <@!206016661470314496> was collecting addresses for earlier. https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/23730 -- does this look ok for other client devs? Please thumb up if so. There's a miner running, so there should be a couple of days of blocks to sync. cc <@&836981603216654336> <@&688101493978562687> <@&652918665943056397> Thank you! Thx I take it Ropsten will go offline soon? If only we could also reset Goerli and Rinkeby to get rid of Constantinople Well, ropsten isn't being actively maintained by "us" -- I guess it will stay online as long as people mine on it might as well remove chainspec for it from the code Sooner or later, yes, but not immediately. Let's give projects/people some time to migrate over first
